status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child narrates Luke 17:11-19: ten lepers call to Jesus from a distance, he sends them to the priests, they are healed on the way, only one, a Samaritan, returns to thank God, and the child names ways of thanking God each day.

floor.prerequisite: Knows why we say thank you.
floor.question: Why should we thank people who help us?
floor.answer: Because they were kind (it shows we value them)

representations: ten figures drawn, one turning back
a thank-you list on the board
steps: Ten lepers call from far off.
Jesus sends them to the priests.
They are healed as they go.
One, a Samaritan, comes back to thank.

board.do: Draw ten figures walking away and one turning back.
Point at the one turning back.
board.say: Who was he and why did he come back?

board.do: Wait for the child to say a Samaritan, to thank God.
Write three ways to thank God today.

misconceptions.ask: How many of the ten lepers came back to thank Jesus?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 17:15 and 17:17: "Where are the other nine?"

misconceptions.ask: Who was the man who came back to thank Jesus?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 17:16: "and he was a Samaritan".
List five things to thank God for today.

listen_for: As soon as Jesus touched them
misconceptions.ask: When were the ten lepers healed (Luke 17:14)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 17:14: "as they went, they were cleansed". Act walking away and being healed on the road.

checks.question: How many lepers came back to thank Jesus?
Name one way to thank God every day.
checks.answer: Pray a thank-you prayer (sing, share, help others)
